groups.principle: Joint and several liability among multiple controllers/processors
groups.reason: The provided policy documents mention third-party data processors and Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), but do not contain any documentation or clauses acknowledging that any responsible party may be held liable for the entire damage in joint processing arrangements. The provided policy documents state that processors must sign a DPA prior to receiving personal data, but do not contain any evidence or terms addressing the right to reclaim a proportionate share of compensation from other responsible parties.
